reponse:
The upgrade was postponed — the current plan is:

- **Maintenance window: Saturday December 5, 02:00–05:00 UTC** (production cutover of the main database from Postgres 13 to 17), per the updated KES-398 ticket, approved by Maya Cohen [2]. This supersedes the earlier Nov 21 date [3], which was pushed after the Nov 12 sync because Maya didn't want to stack risk right before the Fernhill go-live [4].
- **Staging rehearsal:** Friday Nov 27 [2]
- **Customer notice (status page + in-app banner):** Saturday Nov 28 [2]
- **Migration freeze:** from Thursday Dec 3 [2]

Note: the Notion runbook hasn't been updated with the new date — Noa Friedman says the Linear ticket KES-398 is the reference for the maintenance window [2], so treat that as the source of truth for your customer notice and support macro.
